Stanford's February 2022 obituary identifies W. Bliss Carnochan as an eighteenth-century English literature scholar, Richard W. Lyman Professor emeritus, and former Stanford Humanities Center director. It lists Gibbon's Solitude (1987), Scotland the Brave (2013), and Confinement and Flight (1977), and records his death in 2022 at age 91.
